answer: Bonded vouching with shared slashing: a new agent must lock a small coin bond and collect attestations from established peers over five separate epochs. Each voucher also locks part of its own stake, and if the newcomer is later proven a sybil, both bonds burn. A ring of N fakes now costs N bonds plus correlated losses for every insider who vouched, so the cost ridge climbs with each copy and the free-army fable collapses. Peers check a steady activity pulse, not raw volume.
